storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP RedGifs Downloader makes it easy to save videos and GIFs from RedGifs.com to your computer.

How it works: Go to any video page on RedGifs, and either click the download button on the player or the extension icon in your toolbar. The extension connects to the RedGifs API, detects available formats, shows quality options, and downloads the video as a standard MP4 file.

It handles HLS streaming and API authentication automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. Videos save directly to your Downloads folder in an organized RedGifs subfolder.

Key features:
- Automatic video detection via RedGifs API and page scanning
- In-page download button right on the video player
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Quality selection from all available resolutions
- Real-time download progress with speed indicators
- Right-click context menu for quick downloads
- Desktop notifications when downloads complete
- Side panel UI with video, image, and text tabs
- Feed page scanning — detect and download multiple videos
- Dark-themed UI with sky blue accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to RedGifs.com and find a video
3. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon
4. Select quality and download — saved as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I download a video?
faq.answer: Go to any video page on RedGifs.com. Then click the download button on the player, click the extension icon, or right-click and select "Download RedGifs Video."

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension retrieves all available qualities from the RedGifs API — typically multiple resolutions. Formats are sorted by quality (highest first), with MP4 preferred over HLS.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Videos automatically save to a RedGifs subfolder inside your browser's default Downloads directory.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Can I download from feed pages?
faq.answer: Yes. The extension scans feed and search pages, detecting multiple videos. Use the side panel to see all detected videos, images, and text.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding my video?
faq.answer: Make sure you are on a RedGifs.com page. If the video is not detected, try refreshing the page. The extension needs the page to fully load before detection works.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Video processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
